title: A price that is not a number rejects the whole dataset
purpose: The loader validates and never repairs: a bad value is an error naming its line and column, not a skipped or zeroed row.

provenance.derived_by: by hand, from the strategy document and the fixture bars; not copied from any run of the tool
sources: docs/STRATEGY_LAB.md section 7 (dataset CSV rules) and section 6 (exit status 3)
derivation: line 1 is the header; line 3 (the second data row) has the price 'abc'
docs/STRATEGY_LAB.md section 7: price must be a finite number greater than 0; every refusal names a line and a column
so one problem is expected: line 3, column price, and the run is refused (exit status 3, dataset error)
cross_checks: tests/strategy_lab/test_cli_contract.py (invalid prices and row-specific errors name their lines)
